title: The method for integrating dual-color fluorescence colocalization and single molecule photobleaching technology on the theophylline sensing platform
author: Zhang, Liu, et al.

steps.title: Reconstitute RNA strands
steps.instruction: Retrieve lyophilized RNA from a –20 °C freezer, centrifuge at 4000 rpm for 1 min to collect the powder at the tube wall, add DPEC‑treated water, reseal and vortex until fully dissolved.

substeps.instruction: Store any unused RNA at ≤ –20 °C in individual aliquots to avoid multiple freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Prepare FITC‑2‑Apt1‑SA complex
steps.instruction: Premix streptavidin with FITC‑2‑Apt1‑biotin at a 1:4 molar ratio, incubate at 37 °C for 30 min, then purify on a streptavidin‑resin column and bring the final volume to 3 mL while monitoring absorbance at 280 nm.

substeps.instruction: Mix streptavidin and FITC‑2‑Apt1‑biotin (1:4 molar ratio) and keep at 37 °C for 30 min.
Equilibrate streptavidin resin to room temperature and pack 10 µL resin into a spin column.
Centrifuge the column at 500 g for 1 min to remove storage buffer.
Add 1 mL buffer, centrifuge at 500 g for 1 min; repeat this wash step twice more (total three washes).
Add 125 µL of the premixed solution (20 µM) to the column, incubate at room temperature for 10 min, then centrifuge at 500 g for 1 min and collect the eluate (first fraction).
Wash the column with 1 mL buffer, centrifuge and collect the eluate (second fraction); repeat the wash once more and collect the third fraction.
Combine the three eluate fractions and adjust the total volume to 3 mL with buffer.
Measure the concentration of the FITC‑2‑Apt1‑SA complex by absorbance at 280 nm.

steps.title: Make detection solution
steps.instruction: Mix Cy5‑Apt2 and FITC‑2‑Apt1‑SA at an 8:1 molar ratio in DPEC‑treated PBS (0.01 M, pH 7.4) to generate the theophylline detection solution.

steps.title: Prepare tea extract
steps.instruction: Produce a tea‑based sample matrix by extracting dried tea, filtering, and diluting.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 5 g dried tea precisely.
Transfer the tea into a 300 mL triangular bottle.
Add 100 mL distilled water, bring to a boil and maintain boiling for 15 min.
Filter the hot extract with a vacuum pump; extract the filter residue twice with 50 mL boiling water each time.
Combine the filtrates and bring the total volume to 200 mL.
Dilute the 200 mL extract 100‑fold with DPEC‑treated water and seal the solution at 30 °C for later use.

steps.title: Assemble detection assay
steps.instruction: Dilute the probe to 8 nM Cy5‑Apt2 and 1 nM FITC‑2‑Apt1‑SA, mix with theophylline (or control) at a 1:2 volume ratio, incubate, then mount on a slide, seal, and incubate before microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the probe solution to 8 nM Cy5‑Apt2 and 1 nM FITC‑2‑Apt1‑SA.
Add target (theophylline or control) to the probe solution at a 1:2 (target:probe) volume ratio.
Incubate the mixture at 25 °C for 0.5 h; the final target concentration should be in the range of 1–8 nM.
Pipette 4 µL of the reaction mixture onto the surface of a clean glass slide.
Gently place a coverslip over the droplet, sealing the edges with nail polish to prevent evaporation.
Incubate the sealed slide in a 37 °C water bath for an additional 10 min.
Proceed to fluorescence microscopy observation.
